mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `message` WHERE to_user_id = #{toUserId} AND is_read = 0

SELECT other.id AS peer_id, other.nickname AS peer_nickname, other.avatar AS peer_avatar, m.id AS last_message_id, m.from_user_id AS last_from_user_id, m.content AS last_content, m.created_at AS last_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `message` x WHERE x.to_user_id = #{me} AND x.from_user_id = other.id AND x.is_read = 0) AS unread FROM `message` m JOIN `user` other ON other.id = IF(m.from_user_id = #{me}, m.to_user_id, m.from_user_id) WHERE m.id IN ( SELECT MAX(m2.id) FROM `message` m2 WHERE m2.from_user_id = #{me} OR m2.to_user_id = #{me} GROUP BY IF(m2.from_user_id = #{me}, m2.to_user_id, m2.from_user_id) ) ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC
